Version 1.5.0 BETA

A WWII zombie shooter where every shot counts. Pick a class, hold the line, survive the horde.

Next community code at 25,000 likes!
Halloween: Blood Moon event starts Saturday 10/31!

NEW: THE CUSTOMIZATION UPDATE
- Try on and buy cosmetics right from your inventory
- 30+ new cosmetics: hair, beards, scarves, glasses and more
- Save looks for each class and nation
- 9 gun charms and 6 new weapon crates
- New Cosmetic, Armory and Supply Passes

FEATURES
- Play as the USA or Germany
- Class & reputation progression
- 10-player co-op
- Free private servers (With FREE admin commands!)

RULES
1. Exploiting or glitch abuse = permanent ban
2. Toxicity or bad chat = ban
3. Inappropriate symbols/images = ban
4. Griefing or delaying rounds = ban
5. Report system misuse = potential ban
6. Follow Roblox Terms of Use
